_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Recipe For Disaster#000.src: Meet up with Chef Hamsey in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recipe For Disaster#000.dst: Retrouvez le chef Hamsey à {p}, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recipe For Disaster#001.src: Ah, bonjour! Welcome to my restaurant, allow me to lead you to your seat-
Recipe For Disaster#001.dst: Ah, bonjour! Bienvenue dans mon restaurant, permets-moi de te conduire à ta table-
Recipe For Disaster#001.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#002.src: Oh, do my eyes decieve me? Serait-ce possible?!
Recipe For Disaster#002.dst: Oh, mes yeux me trompent-ils? Serait-ce possible?!
Recipe For Disaster#002.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#003.src: It is you... the novice soldier turned hero of legends! Who would have thought?!
Recipe For Disaster#003.dst: C'est toi... la jeune recrue devenue héros de légende! Qui l'eût cru?!
Recipe For Disaster#003.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#004.src: I have heard tales of your exploits across the lands, mon ami! Je suis honoré! Someone like you sitting in my restaurant!
Recipe For Disaster#004.dst: J'ai entendu le récit de tes exploits aux quatre coins du monde, mon ami! Je suis honoré! Quelqu'un comme toi, assis dans mon restaurant!
Recipe For Disaster#004.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#005.src: Je suis, bien sur... Le Chef Hamsey! Famed across the lands for my flavors, as you are for your weapon!
Recipe For Disaster#005.dst: Je suis, bien sûr... le chef Hamsey! Célèbre partout pour mes saveurs, comme toi pour ton arme!
Recipe For Disaster#005.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#006.src: I boast, I boast. Je peux t'offrir un plat... but perhaps I have a different proposition for us both.
Recipe For Disaster#006.dst: Je me vante, je me vante. Je peux t'offrir un plat... mais j'ai peut-être une autre proposition pour nous deux.
Recipe For Disaster#006.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#007.src: You may have mastered the art of battle, my friend, but what of... L'Art de la Cuisine?!
Recipe For Disaster#007.dst: Tu maîtrises peut-être l'art du combat, mon ami, mais qu'en est-il de... l'Art de la Cuisine?!
Recipe For Disaster#007.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#008.src: Follow me into the kitchen behind me, and I will tell you more.
Recipe For Disaster#008.dst: Suis-moi dans la cuisine, juste derrière, et je t'en dirai plus.
Recipe For Disaster#008.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#009.src: Find Chef Hamsey in his kitchen.
Recipe For Disaster#009.dst: Trouvez le chef Hamsey dans sa cuisine.

Recipe For Disaster#010.src: Welcome to my kitchen! C'est beau, non?
Recipe For Disaster#010.dst: Bienvenue dans ma cuisine! C'est beau, non?
Recipe For Disaster#010.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#011.src: It may be on fire, but... que serait la Cuisine sans une touche de danger, eh?!
Recipe For Disaster#011.dst: Elle est peut-être en feu, mais... que serait la Cuisine sans une touche de danger, hein?!
Recipe For Disaster#011.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#012.src: So, back to the challenge. What do you say to a bit of friendly competition, hehe?
Recipe For Disaster#012.dst: Bon, revenons au défi. Que dirais-tu d'une petite compétition amicale, héhé?
Recipe For Disaster#012.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#013.src: You can work with one of my three best chefs on a dish and present it to me once you're done!
Recipe For Disaster#013.dst: Tu peux préparer un plat avec l'un de mes trois meilleurs cuisiniers, et me le présenter une fois terminé!
Recipe For Disaster#013.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#014.src: I, of course, will judge your dish on the twenty-nine Principes de Cuisine - texture, presentation, originality...
Recipe For Disaster#014.dst: Moi, bien sûr, je jugerai ton plat selon les vingt-neuf Principes de Cuisine - texture, présentation, originalité...
Recipe For Disaster#014.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#015.src: ... aroma, magical ability... oh, and flavour!
Recipe For Disaster#015.dst: ... arôme, capacité magique... oh, et saveur!
Recipe For Disaster#015.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#016.src: S'il te plait! Go introduce yourself to each of my chefs and return once you have decided who to work with!
Recipe For Disaster#016.dst: S'il te plaît! Va te présenter à chacun de mes cuisiniers et reviens quand tu auras choisi avec qui travailler!
Recipe For Disaster#016.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#017.src: Speak to all three chefs inside Hamsey's kitchen
Recipe For Disaster#017.dst: Parlez aux trois cuisiniers dans la cuisine de Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#018.src: Heya! You must be the adventurer that Hamsey told me about. You know, he was almost ecstatic, but don't tell him I said that!
Recipe For Disaster#018.dst: Salut! Tu dois être l'aventurier dont Hamsey m'a parlé. Tu sais, il était presque en extase, mais ne lui dis pas que je l'ai dit!
Recipe For Disaster#018.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#019.src: Oh, a cook-off? How exciting! I'll gladly help you out. Maybe this way I can prove myself a bit more to the others...?
Recipe For Disaster#019.dst: Oh, un concours de cuisine? Génial! Je t'aide avec plaisir. Comme ça, je pourrai peut-être montrer aux autres ce que je vaux...?
Recipe For Disaster#019.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#020.src: If we work together, we can make a Seasoned Voidroot Stew, how does that sound?
Recipe For Disaster#020.dst: Si on travaille ensemble, on peut faire un Seasoned Voidroot Stew, qu'est-ce que t'en dis?
Recipe For Disaster#020.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#021.src: You need to talk to the other chefs before deciding who to work with though!
Recipe For Disaster#021.dst: Mais il faut que tu parles aux autres cuisiniers avant de choisir avec qui travailler!
Recipe For Disaster#021.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#022.src: Good friend of Hamsey's, are you? I'll believe it when - no, if - you somehow win this competition.
Recipe For Disaster#022.dst: Un grand ami de Hamsey, c'est ça? J'y croirai quand - non, si - tu gagnes ce concours, par miracle.
Recipe For Disaster#022.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#023.src: I don't need any ameteurs like yourself getting in my way when I'm cooking up a storm!
Recipe For Disaster#023.dst: Je n'ai pas besoin d'amateurs comme toi dans mes pattes quand je suis aux fourneaux!
Recipe For Disaster#023.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#024.src: Are you still here? Just... go chitchat to someone else, please.
Recipe For Disaster#024.dst: T'es encore là? Va donc... faire la causette à quelqu'un d'autre, s'il te plaît.
Recipe For Disaster#024.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#025.src: Yo, dawg. Name's Frank. Hamsey said you guys go waaay back. Any friend of Hamsey's is good with me, man.
Recipe For Disaster#025.dst: Salut, mon pote. Moi, c'est Frank. Hamsey dit que vous vous connaissez depuis looongtemps. Ami de Hamsey, ami à moi, mec.
Recipe For Disaster#025.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#026.src: Nothin' too sure on what we're gonna cook yet, figure I'll dream somethin' up before the time comes.
Recipe For Disaster#026.dst: Pas encore trop sûr de ce qu'on va cuisiner, j'imagine qu'une idée me viendra le moment venu.
Recipe For Disaster#026.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#027.src: Thinkin' a pie, maybe? Not too much effort there, can't go too far wrong, right?
Recipe For Disaster#027.dst: Une tarte, peut-être? Pas trop d'effort, difficile de se planter, hein?
Recipe For Disaster#027.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#028.src: Talk to Hamsey and choose a chef to work with.
Recipe For Disaster#028.dst: Parlez à Hamsey et choisissez un cuisinier avec qui travailler.

Recipe For Disaster#029.src: Ah, you have introduced yourself to tous mes cuisiniers? Who do you want to work with?!
Recipe For Disaster#029.dst: Ah, tu as rencontré tous mes cuisiniers? Avec qui veux-tu travailler?!
Recipe For Disaster#029.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#030.src: Ah, Brie! An excellent chef... and an even better cheese! I jest, I jest. You will work well together, I am certain.
Recipe For Disaster#030.dst: Ah, Brie! Une excellente cuisinière... et un fromage encore meilleur! Je plaisante, je plaisante. Vous ferez la paire, j'en suis sûr.
Recipe For Disaster#030.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#031.src: Ah, Kale. One of my most talented chefs, though he can be stubborn at times!
Recipe For Disaster#031.dst: Ah, Kale. L'un de mes cuisiniers les plus doués, même s'il peut être têtu, parfois!
Recipe For Disaster#031.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#032.src: Frank! Whilst he may seem rather... relaxed, at times, I assure you he is a most capable chef!
Recipe For Disaster#032.dst: Frank! Il peut sembler plutôt... détendu, parfois, mais je t'assure que c'est un cuisinier des plus capables!
Recipe For Disaster#032.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#033.src: Maintenant, mon ami, head over to your chef and start cooking!
Recipe For Disaster#033.dst: Maintenant, mon ami, va voir ton cuisinier et aux fourneaux!
Recipe For Disaster#033.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#034.src: Talk to your chosen chef about your dish
Recipe For Disaster#034.dst: Parlez de votre plat au cuisinier choisi

Recipe For Disaster#035.src: Heya again! So you decided to make the Seasoned Voidroot Stew with me? Hurray!
Recipe For Disaster#035.dst: Re-salut! Alors tu as choisi de faire le Seasoned Voidroot Stew avec moi? Youpi!
Recipe For Disaster#035.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#036.src: It's not quite as easy as it might seem, but I think together we'll be able to handle it.
Recipe For Disaster#036.dst: Ce n'est pas aussi facile qu'on pourrait le croire, mais je pense qu'à deux, on y arrivera.
Recipe For Disaster#036.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#037.src: Like I said before, about proving myself... I'm the newest chef here at the kitchen and some of the other chefs disapprove of my ideas. This could be my chance!
Recipe For Disaster#037.dst: Comme je te disais, pour faire mes preuves... Je suis la petite dernière de la cuisine, et certains cuisiniers n'aiment pas mes idées. C'est peut-être ma chance!
Recipe For Disaster#037.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#038.src: I've been working on my recipe for Voidroot Stew for months now and I finally have a chance to show everyone what I'm worth!
Recipe For Disaster#038.dst: Ça fait des mois que je travaille sur ma recette de Voidroot Stew, et j'ai enfin l'occasion de montrer à tous ce que je vaux!
Recipe For Disaster#038.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#039.src: The first ingredient is some [Snail Slime], available on Snail Island! We'll only need one for this dish.
Recipe For Disaster#039.dst: Le premier ingrédient, c'est du [Snail Slime], qu'on trouve sur Snail Island! Il nous en faudra un seul pour ce plat.
Recipe For Disaster#039.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#040.src: Next up, we need some [Voidroot], a super rare root found deep in the Void. I've heard someone in the {p} can take you down there.
Recipe For Disaster#040.dst: Ensuite, il nous faut du [Voidroot], une racine super rare qui pousse au fin fond du Vide. Il paraît que quelqu'un à {p} peut t'y emmener.
Recipe For Disaster#040.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#041.src: Lastly, we need some [Moonsalt], which is famously hard to obtain. Luckily, self-proclaimed 'Space Wizard' Astralaus should have some, so you can just pop over to his tower and ask for some!
Recipe For Disaster#041.dst: Enfin, il nous faut du [Moonsalt], réputé très difficile à obtenir. Par chance, l'autoproclamé "Mage de l'espace" Astralus devrait en avoir, alors passe à sa tour lui en demander!
Recipe For Disaster#041.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#042.src: And that should do it! I'll give you a Recipe Book, just right-click to open it up and track your ingredients. Good luck!
Recipe For Disaster#042.dst: Et ça devrait suffire! Je te donne un livre de recettes, fais un clic droit pour l'ouvrir et suivre tes ingrédients. Bonne chance!
Recipe For Disaster#042.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#043.src: Ugh. Stay out of my way, and we'll get along just fine.
Recipe For Disaster#043.dst: Pff. Ne te mets pas en travers de mon chemin, et tout ira bien entre nous.
Recipe For Disaster#043.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#044.src: Make yourself useful and get me everything we need. I'm not in the mood for chit-chat.
Recipe For Disaster#044.dst: Rends-toi utile et rapporte-moi tout ce qu'il nous faut. Je ne suis pas d'humeur à papoter.
Recipe For Disaster#044.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#045.src: I don't want my reputation tarnished by the likes of you...
Recipe For Disaster#045.dst: Je ne veux pas que ma réputation soit ternie par quelqu'un comme toi...
Recipe For Disaster#045.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#046.src: Listen up, I'm *not* going to say this again. Take notes.
Recipe For Disaster#046.dst: Écoute bien, je ne le répéterai *pas*. Prends des notes.
Recipe For Disaster#046.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#047.src: The key ingredient in my amazing omelette is obviously the [Blue-Ring Grook Egg], which of course you didn't know.
Recipe For Disaster#047.dst: L'ingrédient clé de ma fabuleuse omelette, c'est évidemment le [Blue-Ring Grook Egg], ce que tu ignorais, bien sûr.
Recipe For Disaster#047.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#048.src: Secondly what we need is some [Snail Slime], which is at Snail Island, obviously. Any seasoned chef could tell you that.
Recipe For Disaster#048.dst: Ensuite, il nous faut du [Snail Slime], qu'on trouve sur Snail Island, évidemment. N'importe quel cuisinier chevronné te le dirait.
Recipe For Disaster#048.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#049.src: Lastly you need a [Talking Mushroom] which is found on the swamp Sky Island, provided you have a functioning sense of sight.
Recipe For Disaster#049.dst: Enfin, il te faut un [Talking Mushroom], qu'on trouve sur l'île céleste du marais, à condition d'avoir des yeux en état de marche.
Recipe For Disaster#049.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#050.src: YOU FORGOT ALREADY?? I TOLD YOU TO TAKE NOTES!
Recipe For Disaster#050.dst: TU AS DÉJA OUBLIÉ?? JE T'AI DIT DE PRENDRE DES NOTES!
Recipe For Disaster#050.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#051.src: Lucky for you, at least one of us here is competent. I wrote everything down in this recipe book. Right-click to open it. Now get me my ingredients and scram!
Recipe For Disaster#051.dst: Heureusement pour toi, au moins l'un de nous est compétent. J'ai tout noté dans ce livre de recettes. Clic droit pour l'ouvrir. Rapporte-moi mes ingrédients et dégage!
Recipe For Disaster#051.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#052.src: Thrilled to be workin' with you, dude! We'll blow Hamsey's mind.
Recipe For Disaster#052.dst: Trop content de bosser avec toi, mec! On va en mettre plein la vue à Hamsey.
Recipe For Disaster#052.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#053.src: Hmmm, now what kinda pie should we be bakin', here?
Recipe For Disaster#053.dst: Mmmh, alors, quel genre de tarte on va bien pouvoir cuire?
Recipe For Disaster#053.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#054.src: Well, I might be a lil' lazy, but when it comes to cookin', I've got the eye. And to me, dude? You look like a real Skyhigh Pie kind of guy! Heheh.
Recipe For Disaster#054.dst: Bon, je suis peut-être un peu flemmard, mais en cuisine, j'ai l'oeil. Et pour moi, mec? T'as une vraie tête de Skyhigh Pie! Héhé.
Recipe For Disaster#054.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#055.src: Welp, guess you know how to cook up a simple Skyhigh Pie, right? Off you go, I'll be waiting here when you have the ingredients.
Recipe For Disaster#055.dst: Bon, tu sais faire une simple Skyhigh Pie, j'imagine? Allez, file, je t'attends ici quand t'auras les ingrédients.
Recipe For Disaster#055.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#056.src: Hehe, just messin' with you, man! Shoulda seen your face.
Recipe For Disaster#056.dst: Héhé, je te fais marcher, mec! T'aurais dû voir ta tête.
Recipe For Disaster#056.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#057.src: First, we're gonna need some kinda flour. A lil' [Sunrise Flour] aughtta do.
Recipe For Disaster#057.dst: D'abord, il nous faut de la farine. Un peu de [Sunrise Flour] devrait faire l'affaire.
Recipe For Disaster#057.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#058.src: A good-sized [Blue-Ring Grook Egg] should give us a lil' kick. Not as much as those grooks'll give you a kick if they see you pilfering their eggs, though!
Recipe For Disaster#058.dst: Un bon gros [Blue-Ring Grook Egg] devrait relever le tout. Moins que les coups de pied des grooks s'ils te voient chiper leurs oeufs, ceci dit!
Recipe For Disaster#058.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#059.src: Finally, the secret ingredient - A [Skyhigh Raspberry]. Real good stuff, but it's a fair way out. Guess a lil' walking never hurt anyone, huh? Not that I've ever bothered.
Recipe For Disaster#059.dst: Enfin, l'ingrédient secret - une [Skyhigh Raspberry]. Un vrai délice, mais c'est un peu loin. Marcher un peu n'a jamais tué personne, hein? Pas que j'aie déjà essayé.
Recipe For Disaster#059.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#060.src: Huh, you've got a bad memory? Yeah, me too, man. Here's a Recipe Book, just right-click to open it up and check where to grab the ingredients!
Recipe For Disaster#060.dst: Hein, t'as une mauvaise mémoire? Ouais, moi aussi, mec. Voilà un livre de recettes, fais un clic droit pour l'ouvrir et voir où trouver les ingrédients!
Recipe For Disaster#060.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#061.src: Return here once you've got them all. Peace out, dude!
Recipe For Disaster#061.dst: Reviens ici quand tu les auras tous. Ciao, mec!
Recipe For Disaster#061.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#063.src: Welcome to Astralaus' Astral House! Can you get to the top by flipping gravity?
Recipe For Disaster#063.dst: Bienvenue dans la Maison astrale d'Astralus! Atteindras-tu le sommet en inversant la gravité?
Recipe For Disaster#063.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#064.src: Astronomical progress! But this is just the beginning!
Recipe For Disaster#064.dst: Des progrès astronomiques! Mais ce n'est que le début!
Recipe For Disaster#064.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#065.src: ...And why did you come to my tower?
Recipe For Disaster#065.dst: ...Et qu'est-ce qui t'amène dans ma tour?
Recipe For Disaster#065.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#066.src: My Moonsalt? How absurd! I collected mine myself, you collect yours! It's only fair.
Recipe For Disaster#066.dst: Mon Moonsalt? Absurde! J'ai récolté le mien moi-même, récolte le tien! C'est la moindre des choses.
Recipe For Disaster#066.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#067.src: Darn humans, you never listen! I said... Get. It. Yourself.
Recipe For Disaster#067.dst: Satanés humains, jamais à l'écoute! J'ai dit... Va. Le. Chercher. Toi-même.
Recipe For Disaster#067.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#068.src: What takes you here, strangeling? What namings do you have? Hu-man? We claim Humyn! Bad choose, pick else, strangeling!
Recipe For Disaster#068.dst: Quoi amener toi ici, étrangeot? Quels nommages tu avoir? Hu-main? Nous réclamer Humyn! Mauvais choisir, prendre autre, étrangeot!
Recipe For Disaster#068.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#069.src: Looking for helping? How many conveniences! Humyns requires assistancing! You observes, humyns failflies into large crater-rock!
Recipe For Disaster#069.dst: Chercher aidage? Combien de commodités! Humyns nécessiter assistement! Toi observer, humyns ratévoler dans grosse roche-cratère!
Recipe For Disaster#069.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#070.src: Burnmilk run out and one direction to retrieve it is moonsalt! We strike lucknugget and discover moonsalt on crater-rock!
Recipe For Disaster#070.dst: Brûlelait épuisé et une direction pour récupérer être moonsalt! Nous frapper pépitechance et découvrir moonsalt sur roche-cratère!
Recipe For Disaster#070.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#071.src: Refined moonsalt gives burnmilk for spacezoom! Inconveniencing, spacezoom destroyed. Humyns create miniscule Spacezoom!
Recipe For Disaster#071.dst: Moonsalt raffiné donner brûlelait pour espacezoum! Incommodant, espacezoum détruit. Humyns créer minuscule Espacezoum!
Recipe For Disaster#071.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#072.src: Only singular humyn can fit in current spacezoom. If strangeling helps, humyns will let strangeling in spacezoom. Humyns can create new spacezoom given time!
Recipe For Disaster#072.dst: Seul humyn singulier tenir dans espacezoum actuel. Si étrangeot aider, humyns laisser étrangeot dans espacezoum. Humyns pouvoir créer nouvel espacezoum avec temps!
Recipe For Disaster#072.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#073.src: Humyns currently residing on crater-rock, meaning waiting is not result death!
Recipe For Disaster#073.dst: Humyns actuellement résider sur roche-cratère, donc attendre pas résultat mort!
Recipe For Disaster#073.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#074.src: Moonsalt discovered in saltcave in north, strangeling follow path!
Recipe For Disaster#074.dst: Moonsalt découvert dans grottesel au nord, étrangeot suivre chemin!
Recipe For Disaster#074.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#075.src: Just [{~} Unrefined Moonsalt] need for burnmilk, strangeling can grab any left over!
Recipe For Disaster#075.dst: Juste [{~} Unrefined Moonsalt] besoin pour brûlelait, étrangeot pouvoir prendre restes!
Recipe For Disaster#075.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#076.src: When strangeling has moonsalt, refine at device beside humyn and go zoom in spacezoom!
Recipe For Disaster#076.dst: Quand étrangeot avoir moonsalt, raffiner à machine près de humyn et aller zoum dans espacezoum!
Recipe For Disaster#076.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#077.src: Hello aaand welcome to the Racetrack of the Century!
Recipe For Disaster#077.dst: Bonjour eeet bienvenue sur le Circuit du siècle!
Recipe For Disaster#077.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#078.src: One winner, one loser. And Usnail Bolt eats losers for breakfast.
Recipe For Disaster#078.dst: Un gagnant, un perdant. Et Usnail Bolt dévore les perdants au petit-déjeuner.
Recipe For Disaster#078.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#079.src: Breakfast? Wait, did I have breakfast? A little breckkie could be good fo-
Recipe For Disaster#079.dst: Petit-déjeuner? Attendez, j'ai déjeuné ce matin? Un petit en-cas ne serait pas de ref-
Recipe For Disaster#079.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#080.src: Well, no matter. What do you say, adventurer? Enter the race against Usnail Bolt. The grand prize is some Snail Slime!
Recipe For Disaster#080.dst: Enfin, peu importe. Qu'en dites-vous, aventurier? Affrontez Usnail Bolt à la course. Le grand prix: un peu de Snail Slime!
Recipe For Disaster#080.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#082.src: Shame, could've been a great race. See you around, adventurer!
Recipe For Disaster#082.dst: Dommage, ça aurait pu être une belle course. A la prochaine, aventurier!
Recipe For Disaster#082.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#083.src: Well well well... looks like Usnail Bolt has won this one. Again.
Recipe For Disaster#083.dst: Eh bien, eh bien... on dirait qu'Usnail Bolt a remporté celle-ci. Encore une fois.
Recipe For Disaster#083.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#084.src: Not your lucky day, human. Oh well, you know the price for losing. Guards!
Recipe For Disaster#084.dst: Pas votre jour de chance, humain. Tant pis, vous connaissez le prix de la défaite. Gardes!
Recipe For Disaster#084.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#085.src: Wowee! In what turned out to be an amazing race, the human has managed to steal the lead right out from Usnail Bolt's nose!
Recipe For Disaster#085.dst: Ouah! Dans une course qui s'est révélée incroyable, l'humain a réussi à souffler la tête de course à Usnail Bolt sous son nez!
Recipe For Disaster#085.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#086.src: Here, human, take this slime as your prize.
Recipe For Disaster#086.dst: Tenez, humain, prenez cette bave comme prix.
Recipe For Disaster#086.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#087.src: ISN'T THIS JUST ABSOLUTELY FANTASTIC. A HUMAN?! WHO WOULD HAVE GUESSED.
Recipe For Disaster#087.dst: N'EST-CE PAS ABSOLUMENT FANTASTIQUE. UN HUMAIN?! QUI L'EÛT CRU.
Recipe For Disaster#087.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#088.src: YOU'RE THE SEVENTH ONE PASSING ME TODAY AND YOU'RE NO DIFFERENT FROM THE OTHERS.
Recipe For Disaster#088.dst: TU ES LE SEPTIÈME A PASSER DEVANT MOI AUJOURD'HUI ET TU NE VAUX PAS MIEUX QUE LES AUTRES.
Recipe For Disaster#088.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#089.src: EVERY SINGLE ONE WITH THAT DOPEY SHEEPISH LOOK ON THEIR FACE, AS IF A TALKING MUSHROOM IS OUT OF THE BLUE.
Recipe For Disaster#089.dst: TOUS AVEC CET AIR BÊTE ET PENAUD, COMME SI UN CHAMPIGNON QUI PARLE TOMBAIT DU CIEL.
Recipe For Disaster#089.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#090.src: GIVE ME A BREAK, I'VE HAD ENOUGH OF JERKS PICKING ME UP AND DISRESPECTING ME LIKE THAT. PRIVATE SPACE, EVER HEARD OF IT?
Recipe For Disaster#090.dst: LAISSE-MOI TRANQUILLE, J'EN AI ASSEZ DES CRÉTINS QUI ME CUEILLENT ET ME MANQUENT DE RESPECT COMME ÇA. L'ESPACE PERSONNEL, TU CONNAIS?
Recipe For Disaster#090.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#091.src: WHY DO I EVEN TRY. JUST LOOK AT YOU! THE EPITOME OF CLUELESS. WHAT NOW, GONNA TAKE ME ON SOME LOONEY ADVENTURE ACROSS THE SKY ISLANDS?
Recipe For Disaster#091.dst: POURQUOI JE PERDS MON TEMPS. REGARDE-TOI! LA PERPLEXITÉ INCARNÉE. ET MAINTENANT, TU VAS M'EMMENER DANS UNE AVENTURE LOUFOQUE A TRAVERS LES ÎLES CÉLESTES?
Recipe For Disaster#091.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#092.src: I HOPE NOT, IF YOU WERE THINKING THAT. I'VE ALREADY LOST A STEM TODAY BECAUSE SOME DIMWIT TRIED TAKING A BITE OUT OF ME... LIVE!
Recipe For Disaster#092.dst: J'ESPÈRE BIEN QUE NON, SI C'EST CE QUE TU PENSAIS. J'AI DÉJA PERDU UN PIED AUJOURD'HUI PARCE QU'UN ABRUTI A VOULU ME CROQUER... VIVANT!
Recipe For Disaster#092.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#093.src: DON'T TELL ME, ARE YOU TAKING ME ON SOME LOONEY ADVENTURE ACROSS THE SKY ISLANDS? HOW LOVELY.
Recipe For Disaster#093.dst: NE ME DIS PAS QUE TU M'EMMÈNES DANS UNE AVENTURE LOUFOQUE A TRAVERS LES ÎLES CÉLESTES? QUEL BONHEUR.
Recipe For Disaster#093.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#094.src: A KITCHEN YOU SAY, WELL, IF IT'LL PUT ME OUT OF MY MISERY AS SOON AS POSSIBLE, THEN WHY NOT.
Recipe For Disaster#094.dst: UNE CUISINE, DIS-TU. BON, SI ÇA ABRÈGE MES SOUFFRANCES AU PLUS VITE, POURQUOI PAS.
Recipe For Disaster#094.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#095.src: WAIT, WHY ARE YOU STUFFING ME INTO YOUR BAG? HOW DO YOU EXPECT ME TO BREATHE IN HERE?!
Recipe For Disaster#095.dst: ATTENDS, POURQUOI TU ME FOURRES DANS TON SAC? COMMENT VEUX-TU QUE JE RESPIRE LA-DEDANS?!
Recipe For Disaster#095.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#096.src: Hello there! I can see you knead some sunrise flour, don't you?
Recipe For Disaster#096.dst: Bonjour! On dirait que tu es dans le pétrin: il te faut de la Sunrise Flour, pas vrai?
Recipe For Disaster#096.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#097.src: It's needed rye away? Well no worries, friend!
Recipe For Disaster#097.dst: Tout de suite? T'en fais pas, l'ami, c'est du gâteau!
Recipe For Disaster#097.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#098.src: Well butter me up and call me toast, it seems I ran out of the stuff, there's none left.
Recipe For Disaster#098.dst: Ça alors, beurrez-moi et appelez-moi tartine: je suis à court, il n'en reste plus une miette.
Recipe For Disaster#098.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#099.src: I'm sorry if I seem to be just loafing around, but at yeast I know how to make some more.
Recipe For Disaster#099.dst: Désolé si j'ai l'air de glander comme une vieille miche, mais au moins, je sais comment en refaire.
Recipe For Disaster#099.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#100.src: Can you see that wheat field over there, next to the bakery? You can farm up some wheat and pop it on the mill.
Recipe For Disaster#100.dst: Tu vois ce champ de blé, là-bas, à côté de la boulangerie? Tu peux y récolter du blé et le passer au moulin.
Recipe For Disaster#100.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#101.src: Grab a scythe from the tool merchant next dough and get to work!
Recipe For Disaster#101.dst: Prends une faux chez le marchand d'outils d'à côté et mets la main à la pâte!
Recipe For Disaster#101.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#102.src: Make as much as you want, I've made all the bread I need for today already.
Recipe For Disaster#102.dst: Fais-en autant que tu veux, j'ai déjà cuit tout le pain qu'il me faut pour aujourd'hui.
Recipe For Disaster#102.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#103.src: Howdy, pal! Looking for some Skyhigh Raspberries? They work great in a pie!
Recipe For Disaster#103.dst: Salut, l'ami! Tu cherches des Skyhigh Raspberries? C'est super dans une tarte!
Recipe For Disaster#103.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#104.src: If you're interested, it's just a small fee of {~} Emeralds to get access to the island.
Recipe For Disaster#104.dst: Si ça t'intéresse, l'accès à l'île ne coûte que {~} émeraudes.
Recipe For Disaster#104.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#105.src: A man's gotta make a living somehow, so I've set up a system of cannons to take you right up to the island they grow on!
Recipe For Disaster#105.dst: Faut bien gagner sa vie, alors j'ai installé un système de canons qui t'envoie droit sur l'île où elles poussent!
Recipe For Disaster#105.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#106.src: So, whaddya say? Small price for a little adventure, and as many raspberries as you can eat!
Recipe For Disaster#106.dst: Alors, t'en dis quoi? Un petit prix pour une petite aventure, et toutes les framboises que tu peux manger!
Recipe For Disaster#106.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#107.src: Alrighty! Just head over to that island beside me and jump in the cannon - it's perfectly safe, I promise!
Recipe For Disaster#107.dst: Parfait! Va sur l'île juste à côté de moi et saute dans le canon - c'est sans aucun danger, promis!
Recipe For Disaster#107.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#108.src: Find your way up to the island and grab as many raspberries as you want! When you're done just jump in the big cannon to come back to shore!
Recipe For Disaster#108.dst: Trouve le chemin jusqu'en haut de l'île et prends autant de framboises que tu veux! Quand t'as fini, saute dans le grand canon pour revenir sur la rive!
Recipe For Disaster#108.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#109.src: Alrighty, no worries. Feel free to come back if you're ever in the mood for some!
Recipe For Disaster#109.dst: D'accord, pas de souci. Reviens quand tu veux si l'envie t'en prend!
Recipe For Disaster#109.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#110.src: Present the ingredients to your chosen chef.
Recipe For Disaster#110.dst: Présentez les ingrédients au cuisinier choisi.

Recipe For Disaster#111.src: Have you got all the ingredients? Amazing!
Recipe For Disaster#111.dst: Tu as tous les ingrédients? Génial!
Recipe For Disaster#111.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#112.src: Okay you step back and let me work on the cooking, just pass over the ingredients!
Recipe For Disaster#112.dst: Bon, recule et laisse-moi m'occuper de la cuisine, passe-moi juste les ingrédients!
Recipe For Disaster#112.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#113.src: Aha! That should do it! Hopefully I've done everything correctly... but wow, would you look at the color of that soup!
Recipe For Disaster#113.dst: Ah ha! Ça devrait aller! J'espère que j'ai tout fait correctement... mais waouh, regarde-moi la couleur de cette soupe!
Recipe For Disaster#113.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#114.src: You should bring it over to Hamsey to see what he thinks!
Recipe For Disaster#114.dst: Tu devrais l'apporter à Hamsey pour voir ce qu'il en pense!
Recipe For Disaster#114.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#115.src: You got everything? Took you long enough.
Recipe For Disaster#115.dst: Tu as tout? T'en as mis du temps.
Recipe For Disaster#115.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#116.src: Let's get started. Everyone else already finished. Stay back while I work my magic.
Recipe For Disaster#116.dst: On commence. Tous les autres ont déjà fini. Recule pendant que j'opère ma magie.
Recipe For Disaster#116.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#117.src: Mwah! My masterdish is finished. Present this to the chef, I'm sure he'll love it!
Recipe For Disaster#117.dst: Mwah! Mon chef-d'oeuvre est prêt. Présente-le au chef, je suis sûr qu'il va adorer!
Recipe For Disaster#117.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#118.src: And be CAREFUL taking it over. That food could be worth HUNDREDS once I'm famous!
Recipe For Disaster#118.dst: Et fais ATTENTION en le portant. Ce plat pourrait valoir des CENTAINES quand je serai célèbre!
Recipe For Disaster#118.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#119.src: You got everything? Awesome stuff, dude.
Recipe For Disaster#119.dst: Tu as tout? Trop bien, mec.
Recipe For Disaster#119.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#120.src: I'll just take a smallll bit of this raspberry - chef's commission, eh? And let's get started!
Recipe For Disaster#120.dst: Je vais juste prendre un tooout petit bout de cette framboise - la commission du cuistot, hein? Et on s'y met!
Recipe For Disaster#120.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#121.src: And we're all done. Hamsey's gonna love this.
Recipe For Disaster#121.dst: Et voilà, c'est fini. Hamsey va adorer.
Recipe For Disaster#121.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#122.src: Here you go, dawg. Pleasure working with you - show this to Hamsey and we'll see what he thinks. Make sure you don't "lose" any of it on the way over - you know what they say about your own supply!
Recipe For Disaster#122.dst: Tiens, mon pote. Un plaisir de bosser avec toi - montre ça à Hamsey et on verra ce qu'il en pense. Et n'en "perds" pas en route - tu sais ce qu'on dit sur le cuistot qui goûte sa propre came!
Recipe For Disaster#122.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#123.src: Talk to Hamsey with your finished dish.
Recipe For Disaster#123.dst: Parlez à Hamsey avec votre plat terminé.

Recipe For Disaster#124.src: Ah, you have finished your dish? Well, then, il est temps de gouter!
Recipe For Disaster#124.dst: Ah, tu as fini ton plat? Eh bien, il est temps de goûter!
Recipe For Disaster#124.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#125.src: Let us retreat to my private dining room... this way!
Recipe For Disaster#125.dst: Retirons-nous dans ma salle à manger privée... par ici!
Recipe For Disaster#125.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#126.src: Meet Hamsey in the dining room at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recipe For Disaster#126.dst: Retrouvez Hamsey dans la salle à manger, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recipe For Disaster#127.src: Welcome back, mon ami! I see you've returned with a dish in hand!
Recipe For Disaster#127.dst: Re-bonjour, mon ami! Je vois que tu reviens avec un plat à la main!
Recipe For Disaster#127.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#128.src: A stew? Seems simple, but even the simplest things in life can be le meilleur!
Recipe For Disaster#128.dst: Un ragoût? Ça semble simple, mais même les choses les plus simples peuvent être le meilleur!
Recipe For Disaster#128.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#129.src: Adventurer, are you sure you made this dish? It is so good I might as well close the restaurant!
Recipe For Disaster#129.dst: Aventurier, c'est vraiment toi qui as préparé ce plat? C'est si bon que je pourrais fermer mon restaurant!
Recipe For Disaster#129.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#130.src: You never fail to surprise me, friend. Here, take this apron, an essential of any true chef.
Recipe For Disaster#130.dst: Tu ne cesses de me surprendre, l'ami. Tiens, prends ce tablier, l'indispensable de tout vrai chef.
Recipe For Disaster#130.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#131.src: I cannot help but notice that your dish is ready!
Recipe For Disaster#131.dst: Je ne peux m'empêcher de remarquer que ton plat est prêt!
Recipe For Disaster#131.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#132.src: Let me taste your dish and I will present you mine! Mon dieu, une omelette?
Recipe For Disaster#132.dst: Laisse-moi goûter ton plat et je te présenterai le mien! Mon Dieu, une omelette?
Recipe For Disaster#132.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#133.src: Je suis déçu, ami. I would prefer biting into a mule derrière! This thing... a Gert wouldn't touch it!
Recipe For Disaster#133.dst: Je suis déçu, l'ami. J'aimerais mieux croquer le derrière d'une mule! Ce truc... même un Gert n'y toucherait pas!
Recipe For Disaster#133.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#134.src: I see you haven't improved in the art of cuisine. Leave me be, and come back when you have learned what good food is!
Recipe For Disaster#134.dst: Je vois que tu n'as pas progressé dans l'art culinaire. Laisse-moi tranquille, et reviens quand tu sauras ce qu'est la bonne cuisine!
Recipe For Disaster#134.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#135.src: I see you've returned, and not empty handed. Please, show me what you've created!
Recipe For Disaster#135.dst: Je vois que te revoilà, et pas les mains vides. Je t'en prie, montre-moi ta création!
Recipe For Disaster#135.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#136.src: A pie? Why, you must have been helped by Frank. He always has a thing for making pie!
Recipe For Disaster#136.dst: Une tarte? Tiens, Frank a dû te donner un coup de main. Il a toujours eu un faible pour les tartes!
Recipe For Disaster#136.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#137.src: I can see that your compétences culinaires are very well developed!
Recipe For Disaster#137.dst: Je vois que tes compétences culinaires sont très bien développées!
Recipe For Disaster#137.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#138.src: Though I will not truly call you a master chef quite yet, you are très bien! Have this reward as congratulations!
Recipe For Disaster#138.dst: Je ne t'appellerai pas encore un grand chef, mais tu es très bien! Accepte cette récompense en guise de félicitations!
Recipe For Disaster#138.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#141.src: Adventurer! You haven't talked to Brie, Kale, or Frank yet, make sure to talk to them before choosing who to work with.
Recipe For Disaster#141.dst: Aventurier! Tu n'as pas encore parlé à Brie, Kale ou Frank, fais-le avant de choisir avec qui travailler.
Recipe For Disaster#141.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#142.src: Yo, dawg. Name's Frank. Pleasure to meet'cha.
Recipe For Disaster#142.dst: Salut, mon pote. Moi, c'est Frank. Enchanté.
Recipe For Disaster#142.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#144.src: Are you still here? Just... go chitchat to someone else, Are you still here? Just... go chitchat to someoneplease.
Recipe For Disaster#144.dst: T'es encore là? Va donc... faire la causette à quelqu'un d'autre, T'es encore là? Va donc... faire la causette à quelqu'uns'il te plaît.
Recipe For Disaster#144.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#145.src: You've talked to all three chefs, you should check back with Hamsey.
Recipe For Disaster#145.dst: Vous avez parlé aux trois cuisiniers, vous devriez retourner voir Hamsey.

Recipe For Disaster#146.src: Which chef you would like to cook with?

Recipe For Disaster#148.src: Not feeling a vibe with me? No worries! I'm sure you'll do great whoever you work with.
Recipe For Disaster#148.dst: Pas d'affinités avec moi? Pas de souci! Tu t'en sortiras très bien, peu importe avec qui.
Recipe For Disaster#148.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#149.src: Thank grook you didn't choose me. Goodness knows I don't need another ameteur weighing me down.
Recipe For Disaster#149.dst: Grâce au grook, tu ne m'as pas choisi. Dieu sait que je n'ai pas besoin d'un autre amateur pour me ralentir.
Recipe For Disaster#149.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#150.src: Collect [{~} Blue-Ringed Grook Egg] at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or check your recipe book.
Recipe For Disaster#150.dst: Récupérez [{~} Blue-Ringed Grook Egg] en [{~}, {~}, -{~}] ou consultez votre livre de recettes.

Recipe For Disaster#151.src: Collect [{~} Voidroot] at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or check your recipe book.
Recipe For Disaster#151.dst: Récupérez [{~} Voidroot] en [{~}, {~}, -{~}] ou consultez votre livre de recettes.

Recipe For Disaster#152.src: Collect [{~} Moonsalt] at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or check your recipe book.
Recipe For Disaster#152.dst: Récupérez [{~} Moonsalt] en [{~}, {~}, -{~}] ou consultez votre livre de recettes.

Recipe For Disaster#153.src: Collect [{~} Snail Slime] at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or check your recipe book.
Recipe For Disaster#153.dst: Récupérez [{~} Snail Slime] en [{~}, {~}, -{~}] ou consultez votre livre de recettes.

Recipe For Disaster#154.src: Collect [{~} Talking Mushroom] at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or check your recipe book.
Recipe For Disaster#154.dst: Récupérez [{~} Champignon parlant] en [{~}, {~}, -{~}] ou consultez votre livre de recettes.

Recipe For Disaster#155.src: Collect [{~} Sunrise Flour] at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or check your recipe book.
Recipe For Disaster#155.dst: Récupérez [{~} Farine de l'aube] en [{~}, {~}, -{~}] ou consultez votre livre de recettes.

Recipe For Disaster#156.src: Collect [{~} Skyhigh Raspberry] at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] or check your recipe book.
Recipe For Disaster#156.dst: Récupérez [{~} Skyhigh Raspberry] en [{~}, {~}, -{~}] ou consultez votre livre de recettes.

Recipe For Disaster#157.src: You shouldn't go entering private rooms uninvited!
Recipe For Disaster#157.dst: N'entrez pas dans des pièces privées sans y être invité!

Recipe For Disaster#158.src: How is the cooking going?! If you have lost your recipe book, just ask your chef for another copy!
Recipe For Disaster#158.dst: Comment se passe la cuisine?! Si vous avez perdu votre livre de recettes, demandez-en un autre exemplaire à votre cuisinier!

Recipe For Disaster#159.src: Follow me into the kitchen, mon ami.
Recipe For Disaster#159.dst: Suis-moi dans la cuisine, mon ami.
Recipe For Disaster#159.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#160.src: You need [{~} Sunrise Wheat] to refine using the mill!
Recipe For Disaster#160.dst: Il te faut [{~} Sunrise Wheat] à moudre au moulin!
Recipe For Disaster#160.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#161.src: You've managed to farm up some Sunrise Wheat - you should go refine it at the Bakers mill.
Recipe For Disaster#161.dst: Vous avez réussi à récolter du Sunrise Wheat - allez le moudre au moulin du boulanger.

Recipe For Disaster#162.src: Looks like you managed to escape with the egg... that was a close one!
Recipe For Disaster#162.dst: On dirait que vous avez réussi à vous échapper avec l'oeuf... c'était moins une!

Recipe For Disaster#163.src: Would you like to collect some Skyhigh Raspberries?

Recipe For Disaster#166.src: You're all paid up for a trip to the island already, just jump in the cannon on the island right beside me!
Recipe For Disaster#166.dst: Ton voyage pour l'île est déjà payé, saute juste dans le canon sur l'île à côté de moi!
Recipe For Disaster#166.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#167.src: You've gathered all the ingredients, you should head back to Frank.
Recipe For Disaster#167.dst: Vous avez réuni tous les ingrédients, vous devriez retourner voir Frank.

Recipe For Disaster#168.src: You shouldn't jump onto the islands without talking to the Raspberry Vendor!
Recipe For Disaster#168.dst: Ne sautez pas sur les îles sans avoir parlé au vendeur de framboises!

Recipe For Disaster#169.src: You watch Hamsey start to taste your dish... will it be up to his standards?
Recipe For Disaster#169.dst: Vous regardez Hamsey commencer à goûter votre plat... sera-t-il à la hauteur de ses exigences?

Recipe For Disaster#171.src: Welcome back to my restaurant, adventurer!
Recipe For Disaster#171.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#172.src: Good to see you again, dude!
Recipe For Disaster#172.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#173.src: Ah. You're back. Just stay out of my way, I'm trying to do actual cooking.
Recipe For Disaster#173.dst: Ah. Te revoilà. Ne te mets pas dans mes pattes, j'essaie de cuisiner pour de vrai.
Recipe For Disaster#173.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#174.src: Hey! Nice to see you again.
Recipe For Disaster#174.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#175.src: Welcome back, mon ami! Alas, running a restaurant is busy work, so I can't talk for long. Maybe take a seat in the restaurant?
Recipe For Disaster#175.dst: Re-bonjour, mon ami! Hélas, tenir un restaurant prend beaucoup de temps, je ne peux pas parler longtemps. Si tu t'asseyais en salle?
Recipe For Disaster#175.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#176.src: Hey, again! I'd love to chat, but you should talk to the other chefs before making your decision!
Recipe For Disaster#176.dst: Re-salut! J'adorerais papoter, mais tu devrais parler aux autres cuisiniers avant de te décider!
Recipe For Disaster#176.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#177.src: Please go and talk to the other chefs first before you decide to weigh me down with your "assistance".
Recipe For Disaster#177.dst: Va d'abord parler aux autres cuisiniers avant de décider de me ralentir avec ton "aide", s'il te plaît.
Recipe For Disaster#177.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#178.src: Can't wait to work with you man, tell the big man we're working together and we can get started.
Recipe For Disaster#178.dst: J'ai hâte de bosser avec toi, mec. Dis au grand chef qu'on fait équipe, et on pourra s'y mettre.
Recipe For Disaster#178.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#179.src: I still can't believe you chose to "work" with me. Make yourself useful and go and tell the Chef. I certainly won't.
Recipe For Disaster#179.dst: J'en reviens pas que tu aies choisi de "travailler" avec moi. Rends-toi utile et va le dire au chef. Moi, sûrement pas.
Recipe For Disaster#179.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#180.src: You should go tell Hamsey who you've chosen to work with!
Recipe For Disaster#180.dst: Tu devrais aller dire à Hamsey avec qui tu as choisi de travailler!
Recipe For Disaster#180.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#181.src: It is time to cook, mon ami! Head over to your chef and ask them what to do.
Recipe For Disaster#181.dst: Il est temps de cuisiner, mon ami! Va voir ton cuisinier et demande-lui quoi faire.
Recipe For Disaster#181.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#182.src: No sweat, man, I probably wouldn't choose me either. Good luck!
Recipe For Disaster#182.dst: T'inquiète, mec, je me choisirais sans doute pas non plus. Bonne chance!
Recipe For Disaster#182.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#184.src: Hey! How's the ingredient gathering going? Remember to check your recipe book if you're stuck!
Recipe For Disaster#184.dst: Salut! Ça avance, la collecte d'ingrédients? Si tu bloques, pense à consulter ton livre de recettes!
Recipe For Disaster#184.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#185.src: Need another recipe book? No problem! I keep plenty of spares, you never know what might happen!
Recipe For Disaster#185.dst: Il te faut un autre livre de recettes? Pas de problème! J'en garde plein en réserve, on ne sait jamais!
Recipe For Disaster#185.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#186.src: The announcer seems to lose his train of thought.
Recipe For Disaster#186.dst: Le présentateur semble perdre le fil de ses pensées.

Recipe For Disaster#187.src: Would you like to race Usnail Bolt?
Recipe For Disaster#187.dst: Voulez-vous faire la course contre Usnail Bolt?

Recipe For Disaster#188.src: You shouldn't leave the race before it's finished!
Recipe For Disaster#188.dst: Ne quittez pas la course avant la fin!
Recipe For Disaster#188.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#189.src: You've clearly won the race, but everyone seems to be waiting for Usnail Bolt to finish as well...
Recipe For Disaster#189.dst: Vous avez clairement gagné la course, mais tout le monde semble attendre qu'Usnail Bolt finisse aussi...
Recipe For Disaster#189.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#190.src: Looks like this is that "Space Wizard"'s tower... you should start looking around for some Moonsalt.
Recipe For Disaster#190.dst: On dirait que c'est la tour de ce "Mage de l'espace"... vous devriez chercher un peu de Moonsalt.

Recipe For Disaster#191.src: A large warning on the display flashes a "LOW FUEL " warning at you.
Recipe For Disaster#191.dst: Un grand avertissement clignote sur l'écran: "CARBURANT BAS ".

Recipe For Disaster#192.src: You need [{~} Unrefined Moonsalt] to refine into "burnmilk fuel". Perhaps the Humyn nearby knows how to get some?
Recipe For Disaster#192.dst: Il vous faut [{~} Unrefined Moonsalt] à raffiner en "carburant brûlelait". Le Humyn d'à côté sait peut-être comment en obtenir?

Recipe For Disaster#193.src: Looks like this is the Moonsalt Cave... you should head deeper to find some salt.
Recipe For Disaster#193.dst: On dirait la grotte du Moonsalt... enfoncez-vous plus loin pour trouver du sel.

Recipe For Disaster#194.src: You grab a large handful of the unrefined salt.
Recipe For Disaster#194.dst: Vous prenez une grosse poignée de sel non raffiné.

Recipe For Disaster#195.src: You've secured some Unrefined Moonsalt, time to head back to the village and your way home.
Recipe For Disaster#195.dst: Vous avez obtenu de l'Unrefined Moonsalt, il est temps de retourner au village et de rentrer.

Recipe For Disaster#196.src: You've managed to refine the moonsalt into some kind of fuel, you should head over to the spaceship now.
Recipe For Disaster#196.dst: Vous avez réussi à raffiner le moonsalt en une sorte de carburant, vous devriez aller au vaisseau spatial maintenant.

Recipe For Disaster#197.src: You fill the ship up with the burnmilk and press the button on the control panel that is helpefully labelled "TRAVEL SPACEZOOM".
Recipe For Disaster#197.dst: Vous remplissez le vaisseau de brûlelait et appuyez sur le bouton du tableau de bord, obligeamment marqué "VOYAGER ESPACEZOUM".

Recipe For Disaster#198.src: Looks like you're safely back in the {p}, and with some Moonsalt to boot!
Recipe For Disaster#198.dst: On dirait que le retour à {p} s'est bien passé, et avec du Moonsalt en prime!

Recipe For Disaster#199.src: The recipe book says voidroot only grows in complete darkness... better start looking around.
Recipe For Disaster#199.dst: Selon le livre de recettes, le voidroot ne pousse que dans le noir complet... mieux vaut commencer à chercher.

Recipe For Disaster#200.src: It's some kind of cargo that's fallen from above... there's a distinct smell of fresh cookies coming from inside.
Recipe For Disaster#200.dst: C'est une sorte de cargaison tombée d'en haut... une nette odeur de cookies tout frais s'en échappe.

Recipe For Disaster#201.src: You reach out to touch the silky leaves of the plant and find your vision restored for {~} second...
Recipe For Disaster#201.dst: Vous tendez la main pour toucher les feuilles soyeuses de la plante et retrouvez la vue pendant {~} seconde...

Recipe For Disaster#202.src: A label on the side reads Ｃｏｒｋｉａｎ Ｍｕｒｄｅｒ Ｂｏｔ. You probably shouldn't get too close to it.
Recipe For Disaster#202.dst: Une étiquette sur le côté indique Ｃｏｒｋｉａｎ Ｍｕｒｄｅｒ Ｂｏｔ. Mieux vaut ne pas trop s'en approcher.

Recipe For Disaster#203.src: Dusty grey texture? Desaturated green leaves? Ever-growing sense of all-encompasing dread? Matches the recipe book description perfectly!
Recipe For Disaster#203.dst: Texture grise et poussiéreuse? Feuilles vert délavé? Effroi grandissant et omniprésent? Ça correspond pile à la description du livre de recettes!

Recipe For Disaster#204.src: It's some kind of purple orb, pulsating with a otherworldy light. Maybe best not to touch.
Recipe For Disaster#204.dst: C'est une sorte d'orbe violet, qui palpite d'une lumière venue d'ailleurs. Mieux vaut ne pas y toucher.

Recipe For Disaster#205.src: You've gathered all the ingredients, you should head back to Brie.
Recipe For Disaster#205.dst: Vous avez réuni tous les ingrédients, vous devriez retourner voir Brie.

Recipe For Disaster#208.src: Have you shown Hamsey our dish yet? I'm sure he's gonna love it!
Recipe For Disaster#208.dst: Tu as déjà montré notre plat à Hamsey? Je suis sûre qu'il va adorer!
Recipe For Disaster#208.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#209.src: Can't say your bake looks very good. No match for Kale's mighty omelette!
Recipe For Disaster#209.dst: Ta pâtisserie n'a pas l'air terrible. Elle ne fait pas le poids face à la puissante omelette de Kale!
Recipe For Disaster#209.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#211.src: Meet me in my dining room and we'll taste your dish!
Recipe For Disaster#211.dst: Retrouve-moi dans ma salle à manger et nous goûterons ton plat!
Recipe For Disaster#211.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#212.src: These eggs look almost... furry? It's probably best to leave them alone.
Recipe For Disaster#212.dst: Ces oeufs ont l'air presque... poilus? Mieux vaut sans doute ne pas y toucher.

Recipe For Disaster#213.src: It's a strange grey fruit that's cold and dry to the touch... not the voidroot you're looking for though.
Recipe For Disaster#213.dst: C'est un étrange fruit gris, froid et sec au toucher... mais ce n'est pas le voidroot que vous cherchez.
